steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject with username 'admin' and password 'bench-admin-pass' and confirm you reach the signed-in home page (report the page title or visible heading you see after login).

02-open: Navigate to the project named 'Bench Project' and open its work packages list. Find all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:' and report each subject EXACTLY as displayed, character for character, as a list. Do not modify anything — this is read-only. Also report how many work packages exist in the project in total.

03-create: In the project 'Bench Project' (http://127.0.0.1:8090/projects/bench-project/work_packages), create a NEW work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Created by bench run {{runid}}'). Save it. Then report the work package's numeric ID as displayed by the app (OpenProject shows it like '#123'), its subject, type, and the description text as saved. Do not modify any existing work package whose subject starts with 'Seed:'.

04-open: Open work package #{{03-create.url.p4}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project' (URL http://127.0.0.1:8090/projects/bench-project/work_packages/details/{{03-create.url.p4}}/overview). Set its Assignee field to the user named 'Bench Assignee'. The assignee field is an autocomplete: type the name and then actually SELECT the matching option from the dropdown that appears (clicking it), so the value is committed — not merely typed. Then verify the assignee is saved by re-reading the field, and report the assignee name exactly as displayed after saving.

05-verify: On work package #{{03-create.url.p4}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project' ({{04-open.url}}), do two things and verify both: (1) set its Status to 'In progress' (the status is edited in place — click it, pick 'In progress' from the dropdown, and it saves on its own; confirm the '{{04-open.alert_on_save}}' alert appears); (2) set its Finish date to 2026-12-31 (also edited in place; confirm it saves). Then reload the page and report the Status and Finish date exactly as displayed.

06-add: On work package #{{03-create.url.p4}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project' ({{04-open.url}}), add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench run {{runid}} comment'). Submit the comment, then verify it appears in the work package's activity/comments area and report the comment text exactly as displayed, plus the author shown.

07-open: Final read-only verification of work package #{{03-create.url.p4}} in project 'Bench Project' ({{04-open.url}}). Open it fresh and report, exactly as displayed: (a) the numeric ID shown (e.g. '#{{03-create.url.p4}}'), (b) the subject, (c) the type, (d) the Assignee, (e) the Status, (f) the Finish date, (g) the description text, and (h) whether a comment containing '{{runid}}' is present in the activity (quote it). Do not change anything.

08-report: Read-only check: in project 'Bench Project' work packages list (http://127.0.0.1:8090/projects/bench-project/work_packages), make sure no status filter is hiding rows (clear/reset any filters if needed), and report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:' exactly as shown, plus confirm none of them were modified (their status should still be '{{05-verify.status_before}}'). Do not edit anything.
